commandContract.minFPSSyntax: Fourth argument must be exactly ASCII 30 or 60; reject decimals, whitespace, signs, exponents, embedded NUL and other values. More than four arguments returns usage.
commandContract.labelPolicy: 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_/-, starting alphanumeric; Windows reserved device names rejected.
commandContract.numericSyntax: Unsigned decimal only; no exponent, signs, whitespace, non-finite values or trailing text.
commandContract.worldPolicy: Explicit begun-play PIE/game world on the game thread; no editor-world fallback or automatic capture.
commandContract.stopPolicy: No arguments. Finalizes at the next engine-frame boundary; stop before the first boundary can yield noSamples.

nativeInterfaces: FMetrics::MeetsTargetMinimumFPS(int32) const -> bool; selects a frame predicate, rejects unsupported targets and empty metrics

definiteIssuesFixed: Added the explicit UnrealClient.h include for FViewport member calls instead of relying on transitive or unity-build includes.
Read each metadata CVar once, then finite-check and serialize that same value; removed the second unchecked read.

Replaced the AppendChar-based embedded-NUL test fixture with direct indexed mutation of allocated FString storage and explicit length/NUL/suffix checks. The original rejection assertion and production validation remain intact.
verifiedByInspection: Shared FPlatformTime::Seconds timestamp per GFrameCounter at OnBeginFrame; strictly contiguous engine frames, not smoothed/world delta time.
First boundary primes the clock; whole intervals starting before the separately bounded warmup deadline are excluded, including the crossing frame.
Measured duration is the compensated sum of complete post-warmup intervals; the final interval is not clipped and hitches are not filtered.
Average FPS is count/sum(seconds); minimum FPS is 1/max(seconds). The all-frames-60 predicate uses worst-frame budget comparisons, never average FPS.
Strict over-budget count and separately disclosed 0.000001 ms numerical tolerance; sorted type-7 p50/p95/p99 do not reorder the raw trace.
Non-positive, non-finite or unrepresentable samples and invalid/non-advancing boundaries fail explicitly; 120000 measured-frame cap never silently drops samples.
JSON contains raw frame times, metrics/status/error, timing policy, warmup, label, world, viewport size/mode/focus, quality/timing CVars, GPU name and engine-version metadata.
Scenario/settings are read-only start/end snapshots; GPU bottleneck and presentation-cadence claims are explicitly not made.
No user/machine identity, command line, window title, engine branch or absolute project/asset path is collected in reports.
Only explicit Start arms capture; teardown reports interruption and excludes the unfinished final interval.
30-FPS strict and tolerance counts use the exact 1/30-second budget independently of unchanged 60-FPS comparisons.
scenarioTargetMet selects the 30/60 per-frame predicate, never average FPS; failed/no-sample metric fields and verdict are null.
r.DontLimitOnBattery is added only to the read-only, finite-checked start/end CVar snapshots.

nextPerformanceIterationProposal.goals: Normal flight/light actions: >=60 FPS. Major destruction: sub-60 dips acceptable, prefer >=30 FPS even at maximal load; 30 is a target, not a demonstrated guarantee.
nextPerformanceIterationProposal.targetValidation: Fourth positional argument is exactly 30 or 60; default 60. Native options use an integer with the same validation. Stop stays unchanged.
nextPerformanceIterationProposal.compatibility: All existing 0..3-argument Start invocations and 60-FPS fields retain their meaning. Target selection changes report interpretation only, never sampling, gameplay, CVars or FPS caps. No target inference from labels.

additiveJsonFields.scenarioTargetMinimumFPS: Integer 60 by default, explicitly 30 for heavy-destruction captures.
additiveJsonFields.frameBudget30Milliseconds: 1000.0/30.0 (33.333333... ms), NOT a rounded 33.333 ms comparison threshold.
additiveJsonFields.framesOver30FPSBudget: Strict count of accepted raw frameSeconds > 1.0/30.0.
additiveJsonFields.framesOver30FPSBudgetWithTolerance: Count of raw frameSeconds > 1/30 + 0.000001/1000 seconds; no sample rounding or replacement.
additiveJsonFields.allFramesAtLeast30: Independent of average FPS and the chosen target; true only when the tolerant 30-FPS count is zero and metrics exist.
additiveJsonFields.scenarioTargetMet: Selects allFramesAtLeast30 for target 30 or allFramesAtLeast60 for target 60; null when metrics unavailable. Applies only to captured frames, not completed-duration or future-workload guarantees.
additiveJsonFields.scenarioTargetPolicy: Explicitly describes target selection, numerical tolerance, measured-frame scope and no gameplay/timing mutation.

nextPerformanceIterationProposal.schemaCompatibility: schemaVersion stays 1; additive fields only. Existing 60-FPS fields and metric formulas retain their meaning.
